{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
*8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] [[Cookbook:Self-rising Flour|self raising flour]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*8 oz [[Cookbook:Rolled Oats|rolled oats]]
*4 oz white [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*6 oz black [[Cookbook:Treacle|treacle]]
*8 oz [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]/[[Cookbook:Margarine|margarine]]

==Procedure==
# Put the butter or margarine, sugar, and treacle into a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]]. Stir over low heat until the fat and sugar have melted.
# Add the oats, flour, and baking powder and combine thoroughly.
# Press into two well greased 7-inch round [[Cookbook:Cake Pan|cake tins]].
# Bake in the centre of a moderate oven at 180°C (350°F / gas mark 4) for 20–25 minutes or until cooked through (test with a [[Cookbook:Skewer|skewer]]).
# Mark into slices whilst warm.
# Allow to become almost cold in the tin before removing.
